Also test that after adding records, getSection returns list that reflects order of insertion.

Potential test groups: "Invalid section indices", "Empty sections return empty immutable list", "Multiple sections independence", "Boundary sections (max index)".

Define test cases accordingly.

Group "Empty sections return empty immutable list": test each valid section (0-3) when no records added.

Group "Unmodifiable list behavior": test that returned list throws on modification.
